input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build, so we have deleted the 24-month worldwide non-compete in § 12.4; it also directly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment. If Vendor needs protection for a specific offering, we could consider a narrow restriction limited to a named competing product, during the term only and capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete the 24-month worldwide non-compete binding Customer in § 12.4.
